name: Extra Seconds
description: A little longer at the cutting board.
effect: +2 seconds per level

name: Faster Throwing
description: A steady hand at the produce basket.
effect: Launch interval ×0.90 per level (minimum 0.55s)

name: Better Prices
description: Your slices are becoming rather sought after.
effect: +25% base cut value per level

name: Sharp Edge
description: A considered improvement to a questionable blade.
effect: +0.5 cutting strength per level

name: Double Toss
description: One hand was never enough for this institution.
effect: +1 tomato per launch (maximum 6)

name: Combo Cash
description: Reward the rhythm of a well-kept kitchen.
effect: +5% per combo step per level (up to 10 steps)

name: Extra Cuts
description: Make more of every carefully cultivated tomato.
effect: +1 rewarded cut per tomato per level (up to 7). Swipe again to cut the pieces.

name: Combo Window
description: A little room between the movements.
effect: +0.15 seconds of combo grace per level

name: Overtime
description: A productive kitchen earns a little more time.
effect: Every 10 rewarded cuts: +0.5s per level. Up to 4 bonuses, with a 60-second round ceiling.

name: Cherry · Variety Unlock
description: A small, spirited specimen. Unlocks automatic Cherry harvests.
effect: Adds Cherry to the calculated harvest: $3 base value, small and fast.

name: Cherry · Harvest Frequency
description: Cultivate a greater share of this energetic variety.
effect: +50% relative Cherry spawn weight per level. Percentages are calculated automatically.

name: Cherry · Premium Quality
description: Better-grown fruit commands a better price.
effect: +25% Cherry cut value per level. Applies to its separated pieces too.

name: Cherry · Harvest Dominance
description: A fine harvest gradually replaces less profitable lower tiers.
effect: Reduces lower-tier weight by 10% per level, reaching zero at level 10.

name: Roma · Variety Unlock
description: Firm, oval produce for a more capable blade.
effect: Adds durable Roma to the calculated harvest: $8 base value, 2.5 resistance.

name: Roma · Harvest Frequency
description: Cultivate a greater share of this firm specimen.
effect: +50% relative Roma spawn weight per level.

name: Roma · Premium Quality
description: Careful cultivation rewards the patient slicer.
effect: +25% Roma cut value per level, including separated pieces.

name: Roma · Harvest Dominance
description: Replace lower tiers when Roma earns more per required strike.
effect: Suppresses less profitable lower-tier weight by 10% per level. Quality and sharpness affect eligibility.

name: Critical Slice
description: A fortunate meeting of firm fruit and a determined blade. Activates automatically on a valid strike.
effect: +8 percentage points of critical chance per level (maximum 40%). Critical strikes deal double damage; cut rewards stay the same.

name: Grape · Variety Unlock
description: A nimble oval side branch of the Cherry harvest.
effect: Adds quick Grape tomatoes to the automatic mix: $5 base value, 1.25 resistance.

name: Grape · Harvest Frequency
description: More of the slender little specimens in the next basket.
effect: +50% relative Grape spawn weight per level.

name: Grape · Premium Quality
description: A careful cultivation of ruby skin, sweet flesh and tidy seed chambers.
effect: +25% Grape cut value per level, including separated pieces.

name: Grape · Harvest Dominance
description: An increasingly slender harvest when the blade can handle it profitably.
effect: Suppresses less profitable lower-tier weight by 10% per level; quality and actual cutting strength determine eligibility.

name: Campari · Variety Unlock
description: Two cultivated branches meet in a reliably round harvest.
effect: Adds steady Campari tomatoes to the automatic mix: $12 base value, 2 resistance.

name: Campari · Harvest Frequency
description: A dependable specimen deserves a little more room in the basket.
effect: +50% relative Campari spawn weight per level.

name: Campari · Premium Quality
description: Four carefully tended seed chambers, and an equally careful inspection.
effect: +25% Campari cut value per level, including separated pieces.

name: Campari · Harvest Dominance
description: Reliable returns gradually take precedence over less profitable produce.
effect: Suppresses less profitable lower-tier weight by 10% per level; actual value per strike governs eligibility.

name: Cocktail · Variety Unlock
description: A lively side branch where a steady basket meets sweet Cherry cultivation.
effect: Adds lively Cocktail tomatoes to the automatic mix: $18 base value, 1.75 resistance.

name: Cocktail · Harvest Frequency
description: A few more little arrivals in an increasingly animated harvest.
effect: +50% relative Cocktail spawn weight per level.

name: Cocktail · Premium Quality
description: Small fruit can still be the subject of a very serious inspection.
effect: +25% Cocktail cut value per level, including separated pieces.

name: Cocktail · Harvest Dominance
description: A brisk harvest takes precedence only when the blade can handle it profitably.
effect: Suppresses less profitable lower-tier weight by 10% per level; actual value per strike governs eligibility.

name: Plum · Variety Unlock
description: A firm side branch where enduring Roma cultivation meets the lively Cocktail basket.
effect: Adds compact Plum tomatoes to the automatic mix: $28 base value, 3.5 resistance.

name: Plum · Harvest Frequency
description: A dependable supply of compact fruit with decidedly substantial opinions.
effect: +50% relative Plum spawn weight per level.

name: Plum · Premium Quality
description: Two narrow seed galleries, thick flesh, and a rather exacting inspection.
effect: +25% Plum cut value per level, including separated pieces.

name: Plum · Harvest Dominance
description: Firm produce takes precedence only when the cutting board can handle it profitably.
effect: Suppresses less profitable lower-tier weight by 10% per level; actual value per strike governs eligibility.

name: Beefsteak · Variety Unlock
description: A broad new branch joins firm Plum cultivation to a dependable Campari harvest.
effect: Adds large Beefsteak tomatoes to the automatic mix when the blade can handle them: $48 base value, 5 resistance.

name: Beefsteak · Harvest Frequency
description: More substantial arrivals, with precisely the same respect for the cutting board.
effect: +50% relative Beefsteak spawn weight per level.

name: Beefsteak · Premium Quality
description: Six carefully inspected seed chambers and an exceptionally meaty return.
effect: +25% Beefsteak cut value per level, including separated pieces.

name: Beefsteak · Harvest Dominance
description: A heavy harvest takes precedence only when actual value per strike warrants it.
effect: Suppresses less profitable lower-tier weight by 10% per level; actual value per strike governs eligibility.
